scores.evidence: There are three can-do objectives, and each has 2 or more questions with an objectiveId, at least one of them at apply level or higher: o1 has q2, q3, e1 (apply) and e2 (analyze); o2 has q1, q5 (apply), q6 and e3 (evaluate); o3 has q4, e5 and e6 (analyze). The exam covers all three objectives and has transfer items (e1 「チームで使うスキル」, e3 「ライブラリを入れ替える前に」). The one gap is that o1 is a create objective, but no graded item asks the learner to create anything.

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか」), and the ungraded hook-q leads into 7-1. But hook-q mostly asks learners to recall lesson 6 (its explanation says 「（第6回）」), and the second problem in hook-b1, research output flooding the conversation, gets no prediction.

Prerequisites give the exact titles of lessons 5 and 6, and the lesson recalls them (s1-lead 「（第6回）」, s3-lead 「（第5回）」). New terms are defined at first use with their English names and match the glossary (s1-defs, s3-defs 「コンテキストウィンドウ（context window）」, s3-bg 「バックグラウンド（background）」, s4-lead 拡張機能).

measure.mjs reports 「prose 1913 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.7 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」, and lint --strict shows 0 warnings. Section 7-3 is trimmed: s3-how is one sentence, s3-legacy is gone, and Explore and `/tasks` are out of s3-bg. 7-1 is still at its limit: it defines スキル, フロントマター and 段階的な読み込み, and also glosses YAML inline in s1-defs.

s2-skill plus the 5-step s2-steps is a full worked example. Each step has a subgoal label and its reason (①「`/reload-skills` するまで読み込まれないためです」, ②「Claudeは説明文で使うかを決めるので」, ⑤「Claudeの判断を待たずに」), and it comes before practice, which reuses its shape. The subagent half of the practice (pr-before to pr-after, comparing `/context`) is never demonstrated first, and the example is not faded.

Each of the 4 content sections ends with an inline quiz that has feedback on every wrong option, and several items ask for application or evaluation (q3, q5, q6). The q1 prompt now rules out the setting case (「設定を何も足さずに」). q2 can still be answered by recalling the key named in s2-invoke just before it (「Claudeが自分の判断で実行しないようにするには」 → `disable-model-invocation: true`).

All seven misconceptions in the brief appear as distractors, each with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer that corrects it with a reason: q1 a, q2 b, q4 a/c, q5 b, q6 d (plus s4-pitfall), e1 c and e2 a. Revised feedback such as q5 d (「スキルはふだん今の会話の中で動くため、脇では進みません。」) now gives the correct reason.

The two process diagrams have 5–6 nodes and use the lesson's own terms (「名前と説明文だけ読み込む」, 「要約だけ」). Their captions state the takeaway (「読んだ中身はサブエージェント側に残り、メインの会話には要約だけが戻る」), and both have descriptive alt text. The s4-table caption now names both source tables accurately, and there are no decorative images.

The task asks for transfer: the learner turns their own procedure into a skill, then delegates research and compares `/context` before and after. Every step has an expect, and there are a plain-text pr-checklist and a model answer (pr-model, with its reason in pr-model-lead). The hint ladder is shallow, though: pr-write, the create step, has a single hint (「7-2の `commit-message` を手本に」) before the full model answer.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next asks a new, lesson-specific reflection question (「スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ」) and names the next step (第8回). It is followed by 6 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

The auditor found 4 problems, and all of them are fixed in the text: the q5 d feedback, the q2 d feedback (「フロントマターなどの設定で決めます」), the e6 c feedback (「主に」) and the s4-table caption. The audit records 0 unverified claims. Versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.198), behaviour claims cite official pages, and the worked example runs, because ex-folder's troubleshoot creates a first commit so `git diff HEAD` succeeds.

The lesson uses です・ます throughout, including step expects, checklist labels and flashcards (「`description` です。」). It is warm and free of pressure (「練習用フォルダで進めましょう」), and lint finds no banned phrases. Terms stay consistent (説明文／description, メインの会話, まっさら, フォーク). The ja-editor owns the wording.

The lesson declares a single jp locale, and it is complete. Diagram labels are in Japanese with specific alt text. The only link has descriptive text (「公式ドキュメント（日本語版）」 in s2-legacy). Checklist labels no longer depend on markdown that the reader would show raw (pr-c1 「.claude/skills/<名前>/SKILL.md があります」).

niceToHave: Previous must-fix check: both round-2 items are gone. (1) 7-3 now has 3 new terms (サブエージェント, フォーク, バックグラウンド): s3-how is 「「サブエージェントを使って〜を調べ、要点だけ報告して」と書けば任せられます。」, s3-legacy is deleted, `/tasks` is only in pr-delegate's hint, and s3-bg cites only cc-whats-new-w27 and cc-changelog. (2) The body is within budget: measure.mjs reports 「prose 1913 (budget 1,200–2,400)」 and 「est 17.7 min」 (estMinutes 18), and the brief's Format line matches.

hook-predict: hook-q still mostly recalls lesson 6. Consider a predict question on the second problem in hook-b1 that q4 later confirms, e.g. prompt 「Claudeにサブエージェントで40個のファイルを読んでもらうと、メインの会話には何が残ると思いますか？」.

q2: the answer is the key named in s2-invoke just before it. To test the rule rather than the key name, ask which skill needs it: prompt 「次のスキルのうち、`disable-model-invocation: true` を付けるのがいちばん合うのはどれでしょう？」, with options deploy-prod (本番に反映する, correct), commit-message (案を出すだけ), test-summary and explain-code. Give each wrong option the feedback 「〜は取り消しにくい操作がなく、Claudeが自分で使っても困りません。」.

s2-invoke: now that 「この例はコミットしません。」 is gone, the paragraph says 「コミットやデプロイのように取り消しにくい手順」 straight after a commit-message skill, and a learner may wonder why the example has no flag. Consider this first paragraph instead: 「この例は案を出すだけですが、コミットやデプロイのように取り消しにくい手順もあります。動かす時期を自分で決めたい手順もあります。」

summary-points point 2 leaves out the second criterion that pr-decide and pr-model-lead rely on (動かす時期を自分で決めたい). Consider 「スキルの説明文には、何をするかといつ使うかを書きます。取り消しにくい手順や、時期を選びたい手順に `disable-model-invocation: true` を付けます。」, then re-run lint because the second sentence is close to 60 characters.

The subagent half of the practice (pr-before to pr-after) has no demonstration beforehand. One sentence after s3-diagram would act as a minimal worked example: 「`/context` で前後を比べると、増えるのは主に依頼文と要約のぶんです。」 The body has room (prose 1913 of 2,400).
pr-write has a single hint before the full model answer. Add a middle rung as troubleshoot: 「説明文は「〜する。〜のときに使う。」の2文で、本文は①②③の番号つきの手順で書きます。」
ex-auto: the skill runs `git status` and `git diff HEAD`, so the learner may get a permission prompt. Add the troubleshoot 「`git diff` の実行の許可を求められたら、内容を読んで許可します。」

s1-defs: 7-1 defines 3 terms and also glosses YAML inline in the フロントマター definition. To keep the segment at 3 new terms, consider 「SKILL.mdの先頭で、`---` の行にはさんで書く設定欄です。」 The YAML gloss is not assessed, and s2-skill's `lang: yaml` shows the format.

o1 is bloom create, but its graded items are apply/analyze, so only pr-checklist checks the create level. Either lower o1 to apply (「繰り返す手順をSKILL.mdに書ける」) in both the lesson and the brief, or say in the brief that pr-checklist assesses the create level.
summary: This is a full review (mode full), because the scope check required one: review-scope.mjs --since sha256:49fdb7d006e71baa exited 1 with 19 of 40 blocks changed (48%). Both previous must-fix items are gone: 7-3 now has 3 new terms, the body measures 「prose 1913 (budget 1,200–2,400)」 at 「est 17.7 min」, and all 4 audit corrections are in the text. The strongest parts are the misconception coverage and a clean 5-step worked example before an authentic two-part practice. The most useful next improvements are a prediction for the subagent problem in the hook, a q2 that tests the rule rather than the key name, and a short demonstration of the `/context` comparison before practice.
